cheats.name: One Hit KO
cheats.note: To Win you must get at least one hit or just return your pokemon.

cheats.name: Press Z\for Max HP\1st Pokemon
cheats.note: This will give them Max HP when they are not in use. Just call a Pokemon out and he will then have Max HP. When your Pokemon faints, just press Z again and it will revive itIn Battle Only,Do not use with anyother Press Z Cheat Code.
